name: Structured Data ML Benchmark
description: Provides a comprehensive evaluation of classical machine learning and deep learning models across many structured datasets for regression and classification tasks.
typical_sota_score: varies widely across datasets; no single reported SOTA
reputation: A comprehensive, recent benchmark for comparing classical and deep methods on tabular data that is gaining adoption for structured-data evaluation.
notes: Heterogeneous collection of datasets with varying sizes and difficulty; risk of leaderboard overfitting and dataset-specific tuning; non-LLM benchmark.
